objective: Independently reproduce the existing bounded CRABS defect and repair without weakening the property or bounds.
scope: Roadmap L0/L1 only; existing repair is reused, not reconstructed.

nodes.title: Fix scope and success criteria
nodes.owner_assignment: Primary Codex agent under user execution authorization
nodes.output: Scope record selecting the existing two-singleton CRABS defect/repair pair.
nodes.exit_criterion: Name the exact bounded claim, deliverable, exclusions, and evidence required; no whole-CRABS claim.

nodes.title: Specify the property and bounds
nodes.owner_assignment: Primary Codex agent under user execution authorization
nodes.output: Property contract with expected order equivalence, valid operations, input domain, bounds and assumptions.
nodes.exit_criterion: Distinguish intended domain behavior from derived obligations; label manual authorship; include valid cases to reject a reject-all repair.

nodes.title: Bind sources and compare harnesses
nodes.owner_assignment: Primary Codex agent under user execution authorization
nodes.output: Original/repair source and patch manifest; property-to-code and harness-correspondence record.
nodes.exit_criterion: Verify source identity and compare original main.assertion.1 with repair main.assertion.3 semantically; changed assertion IDs do not establish equivalence.

nodes.title: Check toolchain and execution envelope
nodes.owner_assignment: Primary Codex agent under user execution authorization
nodes.output: Pinned tool availability report and exact commands, time/memory/output limits, environment and evidence destinations.
nodes.exit_criterion: Use repository tools/toolchain/run for builds and preserve pins; unavailable dependencies remain explicit; plan fresh outputs without rewriting historical evidence.

nodes.title: Assign an independent reviewer
nodes.owner_assignment: Primary Codex agent under user execution authorization
nodes.output: Named reviewer, access boundary and independence disclosure.
nodes.exit_criterion: Reviewer is distinct from patch author; assignment does not authorize contacting anyone or sharing private material.

nodes.title: Review and freeze comparison contract
nodes.owner_assignment: Primary Codex agent under user execution authorization
nodes.output: Reviewed immutable property, harness mapping, source identities and comparison policy.
nodes.exit_criterion: Confirm equivalent input domains, observations, modeled dependencies and bounds; reject weakened property, silent exclusion or vacuous success.

nodes.title: Select exact execution scope
nodes.owner_assignment: Primary Codex agent under user execution authorization
nodes.output: Separately routed validation/implementation envelope for exact commands, sources and output paths.
nodes.exit_criterion: Existing authorization is honored if it covers the exact effects; otherwise obtain only missing authorization. This planning request itself does not authorize runs.

nodes.title: Reproduce original counterexample
nodes.owner_assignment: Primary Codex agent under user execution authorization
nodes.output: Fresh native witness, CBMC named-property result and raw evidence bound to original bytes.
nodes.exit_criterion: Confirm the declared counterexample; tool failure, timeout or a different failed assertion is not a reproduced subject defect.

nodes.title: Verify existing repair
nodes.owner_assignment: Primary Codex agent under user execution authorization
nodes.output: Original-witness replay, named CBMC check and relevant native regression results bound to repaired bytes.
nodes.exit_criterion: All selected checks have typed outcomes; preserve valid behavior and the frozen property; no counterexample means only within the bound.

nodes.title: Compare evidence and explain result
nodes.owner_assignment: Primary Codex agent under user execution authorization
nodes.output: Paired assessment, root-cause explanation, impact/reachability distinction and residual gaps.
nodes.exit_criterion: Bind both results to the frozen comparison contract; verify integrity and comparability; preserve unresolved and conflicting evidence.

nodes.title: Assemble private replay package
nodes.owner_assignment: Primary Codex agent under user execution authorization
nodes.output: Manifest, accessible sources/patch, tool setup, exact commands, raw results, report, reviewer checklist and open questions.
nodes.exit_criterion: A reviewer can obtain every required input within the private boundary; no reliance on conversation or undocumented local paths.

nodes.title: Perform independent replay
nodes.output: Reviewer-produced run records, corrections and comparison against original package.
nodes.exit_criterion: Replay both subjects under the same property and bounds without author coaching; run authorization and private access must cover the reviewer environment.

nodes.title: Assess milestone completion
nodes.owner_assignment: Primary Codex agent under user execution authorization
nodes.output: Signed or attributable milestone assessment with replay outcomes, costs and remaining gaps.
nodes.exit_criterion: Declare independently reproduced bounded defect-and-repair assessment only if required evidence closes; no product approval, certification, release or deployment.

dependency_semantics: All dependencies must satisfy their exit criteria before a node starts. Passing a node never substitutes for effect authorization. Structural concurrency is not agent-dispatch authorization.
failure_policy: Persist failed, inconclusive, blocked or conflicting outcomes. Do not advance a success gate. Rework uses a separately scoped successor attempt and fresh downstream evidence; no back edges or overwritten historical results.

deferred.title: Second implementation and later customer pilot
deferred.blocker: Target, owner and pilot scope not selected

open_questions: Independent-host portability and broader properties remain separate milestones
The deferred 48-case expansion, second implementation and customer pilot require separate scope and authority
claim_ceiling: Fresh bounded technical evidence; no admission, certification or deployment
authorization_basis: User approved: Use a separate subagent for the technical replay
